bio: If you consider yourself an avid carnivore, don't miss this simple, contemporary steakhouse – an attractive “sanctuary of fire” where grilled meats are the undeniable stars of the show. Despite this, you’ll also find top-quality grilled fish and vegetables. The menu, created by the duo of chefs Rafa Panatieri and Jorge Sastre (they also run a popular gourmet pizzeria), usually starts with homemade sausages (wild boar mortadella, matured beef loin, country pâté, etc) is designed to be enjoyed with others (the Friesian beef T-bone steak is perfect for sharing), and is complemented by different side dishes.
